item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
seq=''.join(l.strip() for l in Path('rna.fasta').read_text().splitlines() if not l.startswith('>'))
# Use ViennaRNA Python API to independently confirm
import RNA
fc=RNA.fold_compound(seq)
(ss,mfe)=fc.mfe()
print(len(ss), mfe)
print(ss + ',' + f'{mfe:.2f}')
PY"
